messages:
jess: Quick note: new model q6b-int4 shows a small but consistent eval drift on our dialog promptset. initial triage points to paraphrase duplicates + tokenizer fragmentation. propose building a merged, de-duped eval bank with token-span fingerprints and a 2k canary. who can take the pipeline?

tom: I can run clustering and fingerprinting. recommend semantic clustering then exact-hash. will preserve provenance tags (prod / experiment). target compress 8200 -> ~1.8k.

sana: label-ops capacity: we can run consensus-3 for 1.8k; estimated 40h turnaround. need rubric fields: intent / response-quality / safety / tokenization-issue. add exemplars per intent please.

jess: tom use these params: python infra/cluster_prompts.py --emb-model embed-2k --sim-threshold 0.79 --min-cluster-size 1 --max-reduce 5 --out gs://redwood-curation/qonboard/179001/centroids.json. include token-md5 and token_len and note tokenizer-v2 splits. normalize unicode NFKC and lowercase.
	miles: I'll add a 200-item adversarial subset with zero-width, bidi, and mixed whitespace to surface tokenization mismatches. will tag adv-179001.

tom: first pass done: 8.2k -> 1.9k centroids. uploaded gs://redwood-curation/qonboard/179001/centroids.v1.json (includes token_md5, provenance, adv tag).

label-bot: new job created: curation-consensus-179001 | size=1900 | consensus=3 | due=2026-04-05 | link=https://labelops/queues/179001

sana: routing: rare intents -> team-special; paraphrase heavy -> team-core. QC rule: agreement < 0.6 escalates to adjudication. adjudication budget 6h.

jess: infra: reserve 2x A10 for canary runs. plan: run fp32 and q6b-int4 on labeled canary and compute top-1/top-5 delta + hallucination metric. thresholds: <1% top-1 regression and no critical hallucination uptick. fallback = int8 route.

miles: adversarial set uploaded and attached.

tom: action items done: centroid path shared, adv set linked, rubric pending from sana. kicking off labeling.

jess: thanks all — will run canary once labels finish. :rocket:
